Marcus Georgio

The colonel who commands the Molossi during Compromised's Gulf Coast crisis.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Molossi commander

Georgio presents the Molossi as protectors, but their rapid entry into refinery communities makes them a competing power center in the crisis. [1]

Leverage against the colonel

The book eventually shows that the rogue cell has exploited Georgio's concern for David to direct the Molossi's territorial moves. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised identifies Colonel Marcus Georgio as commander of the Molossi, a force that consolidates around Dallas-Fort Worth before moving toward the Gulf Coast. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The novel reveals that rogue agents coerce Georgio's expansion by threatening his captured son, David Georgio. [1]
